response: The impact of Master of Public Health (MPH) programs on health system strengthening in low- and middle-income countries is significant. Graduates of these programs are perceived to contribute substantially to their workplaces and often have influence at the national level. The impact is largely in line with public health educational aims, and studies have shown that graduates can make a considerable difference in their respective fields. Overall, MPH programs have been found to have a positive impact on health system strengthening in low- and middle-income countries, with graduates playing a crucial role in shaping public health policies and practices.
